timezone_assumption: UTC+2 (CEST, Germany summer) for RespiBAN wall-clock times
offset_measurement_method: 5-point nearest-sample reconstruction across the overlap window (fractions 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%). offset_s = E4_reconstructed_T minus RespiBAN_reconstructed_T at each point. offset_after_s = max absolute offset across the five points.
note_offset_before: Large positive value: E4 activates ~15-24 minutes before RespiBAN per participant. This is a sensor activation-window difference, not clock drift. Resolved by trimming to the overlap window.
note_offset_after: Within-overlap residual measured by 5-point nearest-sample reconstruction. Expected to be bounded by E4 EDA quantization noise (±0.125 s at 4 Hz) when sensors are well-aligned. Not zero by construction.

overlap_window.anchor: RespiBAN start (both devices re-indexed to this point)

leading_tail.note: E4 was recording before RespiBAN was activated

within_overlap_offsets.note: offset_s = E4_reconstructed_T minus RespiBAN_reconstructed_T. A constant non-zero value at all five points signals a systematic start-time error; a growing value indicates inter-device clock drift.
